parts.name: patella
parts.hint: The small round bone at the front of each knee — the kneecap.

parts.name: mandible
parts.hint: The lower jaw — the only bone of the head that moves.

parts.name: skull
parts.hint: The bony case that protects the brain.

parts.name: sternum
parts.hint: The flat bone down the middle of the chest — the breastbone.

parts.name: clavicle
parts.hint: The collarbone running from the neck out to the shoulder.

parts.name: humerus
parts.hint: The long bone of the upper arm.

parts.name: radius
parts.hint: The forearm bone on the thumb side.

parts.name: ulna
parts.hint: The forearm bone on the little-finger side.

parts.name: hand bones
parts.hint: The many small bones of the wrist, palm and fingers.

parts.name: pelvis
parts.hint: The bowl-shaped hip bones the legs hang from.

parts.name: femur
parts.hint: The thigh bone — the longest bone in the body.

parts.name: tibia
parts.hint: The thick shin bone of the lower leg.

parts.name: fibula
parts.hint: The thin bone beside the shin bone.

parts.name: foot bones
parts.hint: The many small bones of the ankle, sole and toes.

parts.name: vertebral column
parts.hint: The backbone — a stack of small bones protecting the spinal cord.

parts.name: rib cage
parts.hint: The curved bones that wrap round and protect the heart and lungs.
